Return each qualifying session along with the corresponding path and search type.

args.sql: SELECT DISTINCT action FROM log.main.activity_log;
SELECT DISTINCT path FROM log.main.activity_log;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session) FROM log.main.activity_log;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session) FROM log.main.activity_log WHERE path LIKE '/detail%' OR path LIKE '/complete%';

WITH first_detail AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) as first_stamp
    FROM log.main.activity_log
    WHERE path LIKE '/detail%' OR path LIKE '/complete%'
    GROUP BY session
),
counts AS (
    SELECT a.session, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM log.main.activity_log a
    JOIN first_detail f ON a.session = f.session
    WHERE a.stamp < f.first_stamp AND a.search_type != ''
    GROUP BY a.session
)
SELECT * FROM counts ORDER BY cnt;

WITH first_detail AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) as first_stamp
    FROM log.main.activity_log
    WHERE path LIKE '/detail%' OR path LIKE '/complete%'
    GROUP BY session
)
SELECT a.session, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.search_type != '' THEN 1 END) as cnt
FROM log.main.activity_log a
JOIN first_detail f ON a.session = f.session
WHERE a.stamp < f.first_stamp
GROUP BY a.session
ORDER BY cnt;

WITH first_detail AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) as first_stamp
    FROM log.main.activity_log
    WHERE path LIKE '/detail%' OR path LIKE '/complete%'
    GROUP BY session
)
SELECT a.session, a.stamp, a.path, a.search_type, f.first_stamp
FROM log.main.activity_log a
JOIN first_detail f ON a.session = f.session
WHERE a.session NOT IN ('9afaf87c', '36dd0df7', '8cc03a54')
ORDER BY a.session, a.stamp
LIMIT 10;

WITH first_detail AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) as first_stamp
    FROM log.main.activity_log
    WHERE path LIKE '/detail%' OR path LIKE '/complete%'
    GROUP BY session
)
SELECT a.session, a.path, a.search_type
FROM log.main.activity_log a
JOIN first_detail f ON a.session = f.session
WHERE a.stamp < f.first_stamp AND a.search_type != ''
AND a.session = '36dd0df7';

WITH first_detail AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) as first_stamp
    FROM log.main.activity_log
    WHERE path LIKE '/detail%' OR path LIKE '/complete%'
    GROUP BY session
)
SELECT a.session, a.path, a.search_type
FROM log.main.activity_log a
JOIN first_detail f ON a.session = f.session AND a.stamp = f.first_stamp
WHERE a.session NOT IN ('36dd0df7', '8cc03a54')
LIMIT 10;

WITH first_detail AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) as first_stamp
    FROM log.main.activity_log
    WHERE path LIKE '/detail%' OR path LIKE '/complete%'
    GROUP BY session
)
SELECT a.session, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM log.main.activity_log a
LEFT JOIN first_detail f ON a.session = f.session
WHERE f.first_stamp IS NULL AND a.search_type != ''
GROUP BY a.session;

WITH first_detail AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) as first_stamp
    FROM log.main.activity_log
    WHERE path LIKE '/detail%' OR path LIKE '/complete%'
    GROUP BY session
)
SELECT a.session, a.path, a.search_type, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM log.main.activity_log a
LEFT JOIN first_detail f ON a.session = f.session
WHERE (a.stamp < f.first_stamp OR f.first_stamp IS NULL) AND a.search_type != ''
GROUP BY a.session, a.path, a.search_type
ORDER BY cnt;
